q.line: Couldn’t help but make me feel ashamed
stanza: How can the life of such a man
Be in the palm of some fool’s hand?
To see him obviously framed
Couldn’t help but make me feel ashamed
To live in a land where justice is a game

q.line: Of your wasted life, you should be ashamed
stanza: All your life is such a shame, shame, shame
All your love is just a dream, dream, dream
Open up your eyes, you can see the flames, flames, flames
Of your wasted life, you should be ashamed

partner.line: Open up your eyes, you can see the flames, flames, flames

q.line: And when the morning came I was ashamed
stanza: And please, remember me that Halloween
Making fools of all the neighbors
Our faces painted white
By midnight, we'd forgotten one another
And when the morning came I was ashamed
Only now it seems so silly
That season left the world and then returned
And now you're lit up by the city

partner.line: Making fools of all the neighbors

q.line: And if I never have a nickel, I won't ever die ashamed
stanza: And you still can hear me singin'
To the people who don't listen
To the things that I am sayin'
Prayin' someone's gonna hear
And I guess I'll die explainin' how
The things that they complain about
Are things they could be changin'
Hopin' someone's gonna care
I was born a lonely singer and I'm bound to die the same
But I've gotta feed the hunger in my soul
And if I never have a nickel, I won't ever die ashamed
'Cause I don't believe that no one wants to know

partner.line: I was born a lonely singer and I'm bound to die the same

q.line: 'Cause we are young and we're ashamed
stanza: All of the things we're taking
'Cause we are young and we're ashamed
Send us to perfect places
All of our heroes fading
Now I can't stand to be alone
Let's go to perfect places

partner.line: All of the things we're taking

stanza: Do you feel ashamed
When you hear my name?
